headline.rule: RELIC detector 'a' is called distinguishable from a trivial rule 'b' only if Holm-adjusted exact McNemar p < 0.05 AND the paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI of the MCC difference excludes 0 in the same direction.

old_benchmark_context.note: DEVELOPMENT benchmark (results/final records, results/v2/v2_predictions.jsonl); all subjects were inspected while fixing RELIC, so this is context, not validation. Clusters = source file.

scoring.abstain_excluded: cases without a prediction are dropped (coverage reported); paired tests use jointly covered cases
